PUBLIC NOTICE 
REVISED PUBLIC NOTICE FOR APPROVAL PROCESS 2026-27  
 
Reference to public notice Advt. No. AICTE/ Regulation Bureau-
AP/2026-27 dated 26.11.2025, the following is informed: 
 
i. 
The Payment Tab has been enabled on the portal for the Institutions 
with pending payment. The said Institutions are required to complete the 
payment process of prescribed TER charges along with late fees up to 
11th February 2026. 
 
ii. Only BBA/BCA/BMS institutions are allowed to submit applications 
and make payment on the portal up to 28th February 2026. 
 
         
 
 
  
 
Sd/- 
Dated: 04.02.2026                                                                                                          Member Secretary
